coordinates: right-handed Z-up: x right, y away, z up
note: PLACEHOLDER geometry: realistic estimates, not measured (measured:false throughout). Box sizes come from config/rig.json parcels. The GLBs in assets/models were baked at older sizes; viewer/model-fit.mjs scales their parts at load time to the sizes below. Blender has not been rerun.

sweeper.name: Cylindrical Sweeper
sweeper.note: Every value is an UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER. Frame: can-base centre, Z-up, +x points from the can towards the box stack.

assemblyTilt._note: pivot on the bottom edge of the can on the side facing the boxes (+x). Positive tilt tips the can towards the boxes.

servo._note: Shaft axis +Y kept from before. Shaft centre 4 mm below the can top (115 - 4 = 111). Case is 23 wide (x) x 12 along the shaft (y) x 23 tall (z); caseDimensionsLocalMm lists it in servo-local order (x, y, shaft). The case is clamped to the outside of the can wall facing the boxes (x 33.5 to 56.5, y -6 to 6) because a case centred on the can would sit inside it.

stick._note: attached at one end to the servo horn: the horn hole is 5 mm (half the width) from the end

sweeperPositionMm._note: can centre: 70 mm from the left edge, 80 mm from the back edge of the 300 mm deep bench

workbench.note: The box stack is placed at the centre of rig.json zones.pick. Visual placement only: no collision or stability simulation.
